relevant_schema.table_description: This table is an HR and workforce directory for “Relay User” records, combining employee profile, hiring/termination, bench/allocation and account metadata. It answers questions like: who is active or inactive, who is bench (unassigned) vs placed, hire/re-hire and termination timelines, reporting lines and office locations, job title and standardized role templates, recruiter and employer sources, plus contact and account ownership for audits. Notable columns: HIRE_REHIRE_DATE (hire or rehire/onboard date), TERMINATION_DATE (exit/last day), BENCH_START_DATE (bench/unassigned start), RESOURCE_START_DATE (customer/placement start), Is_Active/User Status (account active/inactive), Job/Job Title/Standard Job Title Template, Relay Department/Company/Office City/Country, Reporting Manager, Email/Phone, Own/Created/Modified datetimes for audit.

relevant_schema.table_description: This table tracks individual placements/engagements of resources (contractors, temps, consultants or employees) with customers. Each row shows the resource and customer, job/position, department/relay team, ownership/audit fields (Owned_by_*, Created_by_*, Modified_by_*), assignment details (Assigned_to_*), contract dates (START_DATE, END_DATE, termination notification dates), commercial fields (BILLING_AMOUNT, PRO_RATE, ANCILLARY_AMOUNT, ADDITIONAL_CHARGE), status and pathway (Is_Active, ACTIVE, PLACEMENT_STATUS, PATHWAY — e.g., Bench/unassigned vs Placed), referral and sales data (REFERRAL_PARTNER, REFERRAL_CODE, SALES_REP, referral rates/fees), backfill indicators and end reasons. Use it to answer who’s placed or on the bench, billable revenue and pro‑rations, upcoming terminations, backfill needs, referral payments, placements by customer/department/location/rep, and time‑based reporting by start/end dates.

relevant_schema.table_description: This table holds position-level records (unique Entity_ID) used for headcount, recruiting and role management. Each row ties a job template (JOB_NAME and JOB_NAME_EXD_OBJECT_ID) to a customer/stakeholder (CUSTOMER_NAME, CUSTOMER_DEPARTMENT and their lookup IDs), ownership and assignment (Owned_by_SAM/Display_Name, Assigned_to_Sam/Display_Name), audit timestamps (Created_/Modified_/Own_/Assign_Datetime) and contact info (EMAIL_ADDRESS, CELL_PHONE_NUMBER, TITLE). Flags like Is_Active, POSITION_STATUS and BACKFILL_REQUIRED indicate whether a role is active, filled/open or needs backfill. HIRING_AUTHORITY and relay/department lookup fields identify approvers and organizational routing. Useful for questions about vacancies, owners, recruiters, hiring approvals, and department-level headcount.
